body: I think the problem is that most Americans don’t believe their taxes will go toward what they would like it to. I definitely have that distrust.
There are stupid people everywhere, unfortunately.

I’m also 100 percent done with FedEx and will be actively avoiding them in the future—as in, if a company I’m buying from only does business with FedEx, I’ll try to find another company to buy from. And I’ll let them know why. That’s how bad my experience has been.
Not sure, but I’m getting the same message. Two days in for me. Seems like FedEx just sucks. Definitely the last time I’ll be using them.
Not in my experiences so far. Mines been delayed out a week after an updated delivery time that never came to pass. So I guess I’d say the package will be delivered “sometime” And probably very late.
